sinopsis.es: Mairen (32) se ve obligada a dar a luz a su bebé en una camioneta de paramilitares que rondan la región, la cual es conocida porque, quien se sube a ella, no es vuelto a ver con vida.
sinopsis.en: In the middle of the banana-growing area of Urabá, Mairen, an Afro woman, eight months pregnant, goes into labor in an unpopulated area. Although her health is in danger, Mairen, resigned, lies down in a tree to await her fate.
